text:
Type: two-seat sofa with track arms
Use: seating, lounging, relaxing; living room, den, small apartment
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, chrome-plated metal legs
Colors: light warm grey, greige, silver
Shape: boxy frame, wide straight track arms, loose back and seat cushions, slim tall metal legs, raised and light, compact two-seater

product.name: NOCKEBY
product.description: You get extra soft comfort and support because the thick seat cushions have a core of pocket springs and a top of cut foam and polyester fibres.
